text:
Maria D.: Quick postmortem follow-up from the missing-spans / bad-aggregation incident. TL;DR: rootcause was duplicate ingestion path + a schema change that dropped a span tag. Action items below — please confirm ownership and ETAs.

Maria D.: Actions: 1) Fix aggregator dedupe + add regression test — owner: Devon K. — ETA: EOW. 2) Backfill missing spans into the rollup tables — owner: Cheng L. — ETA: 48-72h after we get capacity signoff. 3) Re-add dropped span tag + fix ingest schema migration — owner: Anya P. — ETA: in next deploy. 4) Update alerts and runbook to catch this pattern (aggregation delta + ingestion anomalies) — owner: Samir R. — ETA: 2 days. 5) Add weekly check to detect recurring span drop patterns — owner: SRE team — ETA: next sprint. Please reply with ack or adjustments.

Devon K.: Ack. I'll own the aggregator change. Have a prototype branch, will open PR today: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3287 (WIP). Plan: add an idempotency key + unit test that simulates schema drift.

Devon K.: Quick snippet of the test harness I'm using:
```
// pseudo
pushSpan({id, trace_id, tags});
applyDuplicate();
assert(aggregator.count(id) == 1);
```

Cheng L.: Ack. Backfill plan: run backfill job on a subset, validate rollups vs raw spans, then scale up. Need greenlight on runner capacity — @maria_d can you confirm we can use the spare pool tomorrow morning?

Maria D.: @Cheng L. yes, allocate up to 8 workers tomorrow 06:00-12:00 PT. Please post estimate of tokens/rows processed so we can prebook the quota.

Cheng L.: Estimated ~120M span rows, will stream in chunks of 5M. ETA ~48h if we get full pool. I'll start a dry-run on a 1M sample tonight.

Anya P.: I've tracked down the schema migration that lost the tag — small change in the serializer. Fix is queued and safe to hotfix. Deploying to canary now. I'll post the deploy id after CI.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary roll forward by Anya P. (deploy-2026-03-23T09:12Z) — status: queued.

Anya P.: Deploy looks good on canary, metrics stable. patch: https://git.redwood/internal/commit/5d7f9e3 (will promote in 30m).

Samir R.: I'll update the alert flow. Proposed changes: require (aggregation_delta > 20% AND ingest_rate_drop > 10%) over 5m to fire, and add a severity:warning before page. Also adding an automated digest for any span-schema changes.

Samir R.: Runbook link (draft): https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/obs-aggregation.md — please review, comments welcome.

sre-oncall: We'll take the weekly scheduled audit. Suggest adding an hourly sampling job that checks span coverage by service and alerts on >1% unexpected delta. I'll add to the runbook.

Maria D.: One more ask: owners, add a short verification checklist to your issues so we can mark the postmortem follow-up as done. Example: reproduce-issue, fix-merged, backfill-validated, alerts-updated, runbook-updated.

Devon K.: Will add checklist to INF-3287 now.

Cheng L.: I'll attach backfill logs + comparison queries when done. Sample query I used for validation:
```
SELECT service, COUNT(*) as raw_spans, COALESCE(rollup_count,0) as rollup_spans
FROM raw_spans rs
LEFT JOIN rollups r ON rs.service = r.service
GROUP BY service;
```

Samir R.: ETA summary: Devon EOW, Cheng 48-72h (with capacity), Anya next deploy (promoted), Samir 2d, SRE next sprint. If anyone needs to shift, flag here.

Anya P.: small note — I found 1 other service emitting the old schema; will open INF-3291.

Maria D.: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm backfill status and runbook updates. If anything blocks, post to this thread or ping @sre-oncall. :thumbsup:
